name: Mikneiah
title: Levitical musician in David's time
summary: Mikneiah (also spelled Mikneyah) was a Levite appointed to serve as a musician and gatekeeper during the transport of the ark of the covenant to Jerusalem. He belonged to the second order of Levites, played the harp, and participated in the praise songs during King David's reign.

keyEvents.title: Appointed as a Levitical musician
keyEvents.description: Mikneiah was appointed by the heads of the Levites to serve as a musician in the second order, along with other Levites, to play stringed instruments during the transfer of the ark.

keyEvents.title: Played the harp during the journey of the ark
keyEvents.description: Mikneiah was assigned to play the harp (on alamot) while the ark of the covenant was brought up to Jerusalem with great joy and praise.

keyEvents.title: Participated in the procession with the ark of the covenant
keyEvents.description: Mikneja was among the Levites who participated in the solemn procession when the ark was brought from the house of Obed-Edom to Jerusalem under King David's leadership.

keyEvents.title: Service as a gatekeeper at the ark
keyEvents.description: Mikneja also served as a gatekeeper at the ark of the covenant, showing that he had a dual role both as a musician and a guardian.
